title: Forgetting under noise is undecidable
description: Can ongoing positive noise make the long-term behaviour of a finite local rule decidable? A natural noisy Wang rule is ergodic exactly when its raw tile set does not tile the plane, at every replacement rate up to 10^-24 on Z^6 and 10^-30 on Z^4. A related construction on Z^3 gives the same equivalence for north/east deterministic tile sets. On non-tiling inputs the lower-dimensional all-input nonconstancy probability on a finite window F is at most |F| C_R exp(-t/24000), with an effectively findable input-dependent prefactor uniform in the rate; the exponent 1/4 is retained for rates up to 10^-4535. On those inputs their normalized space-time interactions have uniqueness among all Gibbs measures and exponential weak spatial mixing. Ergodicity, Gibbs uniqueness and exponential weak spatial mixing are therefore undecidable at one fixed rational rate. A different family on Z^6, of fixed range 11, makes uniqueness among translation-invariant stationary laws Pi^0_2-complete at the single rational rate 10^-22, under a stated published-source condition C_T; the corresponding translation-invariant Gibbs problem is Pi^0_2-complete on Z^7. The enlarged intervals are paper proofs with exact arithmetic. Lean covers only the version 2.2.0 intervals of the retained natural-rule cores; the machine-family core is unchanged. Finite forbidden patterns give forgetting bounds, while infinite tilings protect distinct stationary laws.
notes: Preprint. It has not been peer reviewed. Version 3.0.0 updates version 2.2.0 (10.5281/zenodo.24207965). New: much larger noise intervals (Theorems D and A on Z^6 at every rate up to 10^-24, Theorems E and F on Z^4 and Z^3 up to 10^-30; Theorem 12.12 with rate exp(-t/24000) on the whole interval and exp(-t/4) up to 10^-4535), certified by an exact-arithmetic program in verification-thresholds/; and Section 14, uniqueness among translation-invariant stationary laws Pi^0_2-complete at the rational rate 10^-22 on Z^6 and the translation-invariant Gibbs problem Pi^0_2-complete on Z^7, under a stated published-source condition C_T. The Lean cores are unchanged and cover only the version 2.2.0 intervals. Every earlier statement number is unchanged. The authors have not independently verified the new mathematical arguments.
